robots.name: Cerberon
robots.description: Cerberon is created with the most efficient methods to provide the maximized velocity, shooting ability and cycle sustainability.
robots.whyText: This season, we named our robot Cerberon, inspired by Cerberus — the mythological three-headed guardian — and cannon, symbolizing power and precision.

robots.name: HILDA
robots.tagline: Into the Deep, Beyond All Limits.
robots.description: HILDA was built for the 2024–25 FTC Into The Deep season. Featuring an innovative arm and intake system designed for submersible game pieces, HILDA demonstrated exceptional performance throughout the season.
robots.whyText: HILDA stands for Highly Intelligent Linear Drive Assembly. The name captures both the clever engineering and the season's deep-sea theme, built to retrieve game pieces from below the surface.
robots.youtubeTitle: 2024-2025 FIRST Tech Challenge Into The Deep Game Animation
robots.gameDescription: Two alliances compete to collect and deliver samples, score specimens on the chamber, and ascend the submersible structure at the end of the match.
robots.robotOverview: Behind every smooth motion and successful score lies a network of carefully designed and fine-tuned subsystems. At Cartesian Robotics, we treat each subsystem not as an isolated part, but as a piece of a unified machine — each one optimized for speed, stability, and synergy.

abilities.name: Chassis
abilities.desc: Transitioned to a lightweight mecanum chassis with a 3 mm aluminum frame, polycarbonate shell, and GoBilda wheels for better control and reliable high hangs.

abilities.name: In-Drop and In-Drop Grabber
abilities.desc: Dual parallel 4-stage slider with a polycarbonate frame and servo-powered herringbone grabber, enabling high chamber scoring via forward motion.

abilities.name: Intake
abilities.desc: Dual 3-stage slider design replacing the original single slider, reducing wobble and improving specimen collection accuracy and cycle speed.

abilities.name: Odometry
abilities.desc: Switched from optical odometry to dead wheel tracking for reduced positional drift and more precise autonomous pathing.

abilities.name: Card Yoyo (Cable Management)
abilities.desc: Badge reel system keeping wires retractable and tangle-free, reducing mechanical interference and improving overall reliability.

abilities.name: Sliders
abilities.desc: Locally manufactured sliders upgraded with bearing-equipped motor holders and a custom limit switch for improved accuracy and reliability.

robots.name: X
robots.description: X was our breakthrough robot for the 2023–24 FTC Centerstage season. Named after the Cartesian coordinate axes, it embodies our team's identity through precise, coordinate-based movement and strategic gameplay.
robots.whyText: X is named after the Cartesian axes — a direct nod to our team identity. The name reflects our philosophy: every move is calculated, every position is precise, and every strategy is data-driven.
